title: ECAS: An Edge-Controlled Agentic System for Validation-Gated Scientific Application Execution
abstract: arXiv:2609.14211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific applications increasingly rely on high-performance computing (HPC), yet translating a scientist's high-level goal into a correct target-scale execution remains brittle and labor-intensive. Large language model (LLM) agents promise to automate this, but two obstacles remain: granting a cloud-hosted model direct HPC access exposes credentials and execution authority, while withholding it demands continuous human supervision; and one-shot generation cannot adapt when generated artifacts fail in a site-specific HPC environment. We present \textsc{ECAS}, an \textbf{E}dge-\textbf{C}ontrolled \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{S}ystem for closed-loop execution of scientific computing campaigns with limited human intervention. \textsc{ECAS} separates \emph{reasoning}, \emph{control}, and \emph{execution}: a cloud-hosted LLM proposes plans, artifacts, and repairs; a user-controlled edge agent retains credentials, workflow state, and execution

translated_title: ECAS：一种用于验证门控科学应用执行的边缘控制智能体系统
translated_abstract: 科学应用日益依赖高性能计算（HPC），然而将科学家的宏观目标转化为正确的目标规模执行仍然脆弱且耗费人力。大语言模型（LLM）智能体有望实现这一过程的自动化，但存在两个障碍：让云端托管的模型直接访问HPC会暴露凭证和执行权限，而不授予其访问权限则需要持续的人工监督；此外，一次性生成无法在生成的产物于特定站点HPC环境中失败时进行自适应调整。我们提出了ECAS，一个边缘控制的智能体系统，用于在最少人工干预下闭环执行科学计算任务。ECAS将推理、控制和执行分离：云端托管的LLM提出计划、生成产物并进行修复；由用户控制的边缘智能体保留凭证、工作流状态和执行（权限）。
tldr: ECAS通过将推理、控制与执行分离——云端LLM负责规划与修复，边缘智能体保留凭证并通过验证门控执行——实现了在最少人工干预下科学计算任务的闭环自动化执行。
en_tdlr: ECAS is an edge-controlled agentic system that separates reasoning, control, and execution—using a cloud LLM for planning and repairs while an edge agent retains credentials and gates execution through validation—enabling closed-loop scientific computing campaigns with minimal human intervention.
